L: Hey everyone, something scary happened to me yesterday.
I was jogging in the park when I suddenly felt dizzy.
My legs felt weak, so I sat down on a bench.
A woman walked over and asked, “Are you okay?”
I told her I felt sick and my head was spinning.
She stayed with me and called an ambulance right away.
The paramedics checked me and said I was dehydrated.
I hadn't had enough water all day.
Now I always carry a water bottle. Take care of yourselves, guys!

exq.a: The speaker felt dizzy and sat down.
